definitions.explanation: A loss of money in a business or account: the amount by which spending exceeds income. A business and accounting word.

definitions.gloss: missing part; defect; being partly lost
definitions.explanation: A part that is missing or damaged, so that something is incomplete: a chipped part of an object, missing data, or (in medicine) missing tissue or teeth. As a suru verb, to be missing or broken off.

examples.japanese: {欠損|けっそん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
⟦{今期|こんき}→今期：29530_konki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{三億円|さんおくえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{欠損|けっそん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: This term we posted a loss of 300 million yen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{欠損|けっそん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{埋|う}める→埋める：01901_umeru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{不採算|ふさいさん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店舗|てんぽ}→店舗：12481_tenpo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{閉|と}じた→閉じる：02303_tojiru⟧。
examples.english: The company closed unprofitable stores to make up for past losses.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部品|ぶひん}→部品：00020_buhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一部|いちぶ}→一部：06783_ichibu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{欠損|けっそん}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Part of the component is missing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{写本|しゃほん}→写本：20963_shahon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{欠損|けっそん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The old manuscript has missing parts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{送|おく}られて→送る：00742_okuru⟧きた⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{欠損|けっそん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦もう{一度|いちど}→もう一度：02976_mouichido⟧⟦{送|おく}って→送る：00742_okuru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: The data we received had gaps, so we asked them to send it again.

notes:
{欠|けつ} (lacking) + ⟦{損|そん}→損：03325_son⟧ (loss). Sense 1 is accounting language; sense 2 appears in technical, medical and archival writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {欠損|けっそん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to post a loss
- {欠損金|けっそんきん}: deficit, accumulated loss
- {欠損|けっそん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{埋|う}める→埋める：01901_umeru⟧ / ⟦{補|おぎな}う→補う：00329_oginau⟧: to make up a loss
- ⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{欠損|けっそん}: missing data

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{赤字|あかじ}→赤字：04712_akaji⟧: deficit, in the red; the everyday word
- ⟦{損失|そんしつ}→損失：04875_sonshitsu⟧: loss; any loss, not only financial
- ⟦{欠陥|けっかん}→欠陥：02793_kekkan⟧: defect, flaw; something wrong, not something missing
